policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.text: All three of the season's silent finals are Lubbock Christian's: each match is marked final and carries no published score. Two more matches are past their date with no result at all — a separate absence, and a separate count.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: One match with a published score has no box score behind it: Sul Ross State's, at home to CSU Pueblo. That is not a silent final — a silent final has no result whose detail could be missing — and the counts never share a match.
